relationships.subject: bufalin-PLGA microspheres
relationships.evidence_quote: The treatment of bufalin-PLGA MS of 1.5 mg/kg could inhibit the expression of TRPV1 protein in the DRG as compared to the CCI group without bufalin-PLGA MS treatment (p < 0.01) (Figure 8B).

relationships.subject: bufalin-PLGA microspheres
relationships.evidence_quote: Hence, it is reasonable to conclude that bufalin may inhibit the upregulation of the P2X7 receptor expression in the DRG (Figures 9C,D).

relationships.subject: bufalin-PLGA microspheres
relationships.evidence_quote: The levels of IL-18, TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-6 protein in DRG remarkedly decreased after the treatment of 1.5 mg/kg bufalin-PLGA MS as compared to the CCI group (p < 0.01 or p < 0.001) (Figure 12).

relationships.subject: bufalin
relationships.evidence_quote: The binding ability of bufalin to the P2X7 receptor was the strongest among these receptors, by considering the absolute affinity value with >6 kcal/mol as the selected standard (Table 3).

key_findings: Bufalin-PLGA microspheres prolonged analgesia up to 3 days in CCI rats versus about 4 h for free bufalin.
Treatment reduced DRG TRPV1, P2X7 and pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-1β, IL-18, IL-6, TNF-α); docking suggests direct P2X7 binding.
